Fitted draws for the basic SIR model

sir_res.Rd

Posterior draws from run_model fit to the sir data using a basic SIR infection process (fitting the recovery rate) and a two-test observation process. Bundling the result lets the vignette display model output without re-running the Stan model. Parameters are on the model's internal scale (logit for probabilities and rates).

Usage

sir_res

Format

A posterior draws_array with parameters eh_prob, ih_prob, and gamma.

Source

Generated by data-raw/sir_res.R.
